failureThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failures before marking replica unhealthy

method.description: HTTP method to use for health check

port.description: Port to check (defaults to container port if not specified)

startupTimeoutSeconds.description:
Daemons only: how long a replica may run without passing its health check before the
update fails, in seconds, counted from when the replica first reports running.
Defaults to 600 (10 minutes); at most 86400 (24 hours).
